SELECT
    OT.SOURCE_CODE,
    OT.SCHEMA_NAME,
    OTR.DATA_LAYER,
    OTR.TASK_NAME,
    OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,
    CAST(OTR.PROCESS_DATE AS DATE) PROCESS_DATE,
    OS.STATUS,
    OTR.START_DATETIME,
    OTR.END_DATETIME
FROM
    OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
LEFT JOIN
    OM.OM_STATUS OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID
LEFT JOIN
    OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME
LEFT JOIN
    OM.OM_TASKS OT ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
LEFT JOIN
    EDS.DATE_DIM DD ON OTR.PROCESS_DATE = DD.FULLDATE
WHERE
    DD.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE IN (SELECT TOP 6 FullDate FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE<CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC )
ORDER BY
    START_DATETIME DESC, PROCESS_DATE DESC, TASK_NAME;
